chapter: Bennie Moten, Basie and the Reno
title: End of tape two and start of tape three
summary: Smith closes tape two and opens tape three, asking Goodwin to continue with Fairyland Park.

blocks.x: And now was it from there that Benny went to the hospital for his tonsillitis?

MR. SMITH: They went East. Well you know, what I think I'll do now is end Tape Two, Side Two of Tape Two, and on Tape Three carry on in -- with the true -- the really true Benny Moten story, which will be told, as far as I know, for the first time and Count Basie with Benny Moten. So this is the end of Side Two of Tape Two of the interview with Baby Lovett by Art Smith with the invaluable assistance of Crook Goodwin for the National Endowment for the Performing Arts of the Smithsonian Institution. The next tape you hear will be Tape No. 3. This is again the end of Side Two of Tape Two.

At the Afterhours, on the third tape of the interview with the famous Samuel Baby Lovett, with Crook Goodwin and yours truly, Art Smith. This is Side One of Tape Three, and at this juncture I think we would like to pick up on where we left Tape Two; that is, when the Moten Band was at Fairyland Park and I'll let Crook take it from there.
